Lemma
[A Hypersurface's Tangent Space is a Hyperplane]

If $dF_x$ is injective and $\dim M+1=\dim \widetilde M$, then \[ \dim dF_x(T_xM)+1=\dim T_{F(x)}\widetilde M. \]
Proof

\sketch Injectivity gives $\dim dF_x(T_xM)=\dim M$, and the ambient tangent space has dimension $\dim \widetilde M$.

□
